notes.title: Our next roguelite... Demo out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

At a certain point after releasing a game, every developer needs to decide what to do next with the resources they have available... and when thinking about making another game, something we really value at Twice Different is innovation. Especially with mechanics!
We want to make sure we're giving you a new experience.

With Ring of Pain we aimed to make a fresh card crawler format which is dynamic and challenging. We're immensely thankful for all the support we've received making this, and hope to continue making dark strategy games with a weird twist.

[h3]Our next game, Winnie's Hole, is another dark roguelite genre mashup. [/h3]
It's a combo-driven deckbuilder where you play as a virus inside Winnie. 
Explore his body at a cellular level, capturing resources to mutate and evolve.

We've iterated a lot to make this game unlike any roguelite on the market, and we hope you'll like it. 

This is the first demo and we'd love to get community feedback on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/twicedifferent]our Discord.[/url]

We hope you'll enjoy it, thanks from Twice Different ːRoPFrogː

Our demo will be live for October.
[h3][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2319730]Visit our Steam page to try the demo![/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Team update from Twice Different
notes.content:
Hello friends! 
I wanted to share some news from the Twice Different team. ːRoPFrogː

First up, we're so grateful to have found some success with Ring of Pain which has enabled us to add a ton of free extra content since launch. I've mentioned in the past that we've been uncertain about adding more content due to our focus being on our next dark strategy game... However, I have some news!

We've decided to give our community an opportunity to be a part of another small content update.

[h2]Item design challenge[/h2]

On our Discord we've just started an item design challenge with a brief. We're interested in adding some synergies for item sets and making content inspired by the community.

This is a chance to get your idea into the game!
We'll be running this event until mid April so check the #events channel on [url=https://discord.gg/ringofpain]Discord[/url] for more information.


[h2]Upcoming game announcement[/h2]

We're also getting close to being able to announce our next project, and we'll be figuring out a plan to do some community testing this year (hopefully pretty soon).

We'll be expanding our Discord to include the next title we're working on as well, so if you're interested in knowing more, [url=https://discord.gg/ringofpain]join us on Discord[/url] and all will be revealed soon... 

Thanks for playing!
Simon and Mess
Twice Different

notes.title: Build notes 1.4.00 - Time Weaver
notes.content:
[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mid-game saves!
 The most requested features since launch: Mid game save is now in the game! 
 Using an exit will auto-save your current run so it can be continued from the title screen next time you play or return to the main menu.
[*] Added Choosable Scrolls which give you a choice of 3 Scrolls.
[*] Added Bestiary tab to the Collection.
[*] Wishing Well now allows you to select any equipped item to throw in, and be used up to 3 times.
[*] Photosensitive option section in Settings with a toggle to turn off flashing attack visuals
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed setting toggles using the term "on" regardless of the selected option, after changing the language
[*] Fixed Twitch item drawing issues
[*] Fixed issues with Flail's projection
[*] Fixed Necklace Smoke to intimidate Crooked Loombird's second attack
[*] Fixed room progress bug when loading a saved game
[*] Fixed saves loading incorrectly when playing in Hard Mode
[*] Leaving a game mid run is not considered abandoning in the statistics page as it can be resumed
[*] Fixed Particular Taste Daily Dungeon to affect mimics and shop
[*] Fixed Demolitions Daily Dungeon to not include already explosive creatures
[*] Fixed incorrect splash damage projection when the player is going to pat a dog
[*] Jousting pants effect is removed on combat
[*] Fixed issues with Swapper and interactions that disable attacks
[*] Gambler's Reward adds health based on the amount of negative stats the player has, and not the sum of negative stats
[*] Dog pat no longer shows splash damage projection on neighbours
[*] Demolitions Daily Dungeon does not overwrite explosive creatures
[*] Particular Taste Daily Dungeon affect mimics
[*] Fixes for the mid-game saves on Mac
[*] Freeze immune monsters properly project their attacks
[*] Hit Owl with spoon achievement now works for all versions of the owl
[*] Fixed softlock where player dies, and attempts to use a door with exit modals enabled
[*] Fixed a bug where some items were considered freeze items
[*] Unstable Tome reverts the equipped Spellbook's cooldown to it's default value when unequipped
[*] Fix for Soul Hourglass leaving empty cards in the ring
[/list]

[h2]Translations:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix Spanish item effect translation for Collateral Damage
[*] Updated a number of Japanese translations (thank you, H_Footstep)
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added stunned animations for when a certain boss is exploded
[*] Stat cards can be discarded
[*] General performance improvements
[*] Added "All" archetype for item cards
[*] Spawn Friend can now be used in boss rooms
[*] Added an icon to creature intention tooltips
[*] You can now search by the description of items in the collection
[*] Items with cooldown effects now all count down until ready to activate, instead of some counting up
[*] Added a filter for locked/unlocked Achievements in the Collection
[/list]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced number of Amalgams in Light ending levels
[*] The Dominant Daily Dungeon modifier start with Soul Spill
[*] Reduce Gnashers in Normal difficulty
[*] Crossroads can now spawn Wishful exit
[*] A Quick Approach won't appear as early
[*] Strikers Veil item effect increased from +3% -> +5% per negative Defense
[*] Feinting Token no longer prevents retaliation
[*] Freezing a Hollower while it's about to cast the Soul Pulse will stop the attack
[*] Added health bonus calculated from clarity will no longer be less than 0
 This means successfully drinking cursed potions will always give at least the base heal amount.
[*] Fire Dance changed from active with 4 or less items equipped, to 6 or less.
[/list]

A massive thank you to everyone who's been playing the game, testing, giving feedback and supporting us to keep making updates.

notes.content:
[h3]Difficulty tuning patch[/h3]

We'll continue to adjust the game as we add more content and features. 
Hard mode is significantly more difficult than Normal mode, but we've tuned mid and late game areas with this update for more consistency, and to give you more access to loot. 

It's still very important to save and manage souls in Hard mode. Buying all chests will mean you're unable to afford higher tier loot and scale your build, which is crucial for survival, and planning multiple turns ahead to maximise your resources and use the dungeon against itself.

[*] Removed Fire Breed from depth 9.
[*] Slight increase to Poisonbead and Firebead spawn rate in middle levels for more environmental damage.
[*] Increased Chest/Corpse quality in depths before most shops. If you can't afford a chest you may still be able to buy a shop item.
[*] Ravaged room can appear slightly earlier.
[*] Made lower tier monsters spawn slightly later as well for more soul farming.
[/list]

We'll be doing some more item balance soon. 
Thanks for playing and providing feedback!

notes.title: The Specialist Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Specialist Update is here![/h1]

As we introduce new features, our long term goal is to make the game more strategic and create more versatile play styles. They're also a step towards the new game mode we're working on.

Giving players more agency over the game means the difficulty may change as we tune it, and if players have more ways to master the game it provides a path for us to create more hardcore, challenging content in the future!

This update includes a very important feature:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/f95fbd8d1cecca13ba1d553563516d238a7ca7ca.jpg[/img]

[h2]Choosable Stat Boosts[/h2]

There are now multiple types of Stat Boosts with different effects! 
These also give you a choice between 1 of 3 stats to gain, to help you balance your build the way you want!

[h3]New Stat Boost types are:[/h3]
[b]Basic[/b] - Choose 1 of 3 primary Stats to increase
[b]Compromise[/b] - Choose 1 of 3 primary Stat to increase, -1 to the other 2 choices
[b]Specialised[/b] - Choose 1 of 3 primary Stat to increase a lot, -1 to all other stats

The Basic type can also appear as a Cursed Stat Boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34440393/cee414487153d403f77901cd2e7d400b94d4f580.jpg[/img]

[h2]15+ New items[/h2]
As we continue adding content we're aiming to keep filling out areas which need more variety, as well as adding more synergies to make existing items more useful! This is a long term goal for us, though we're excited to share our first batch of new items.

These includes the beginning of spell cast synergies, more versatile Stalker set cards and a special frog-related treat...

notes.title: 1.0.28 Build Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Build notes:[/h1]

[h3]Catch me if you can[/h3]
A common feedback we've had is that sometimes it's not always possible to catch the Scrounger before it leaves a dungeon, so now Scroungers will no longer spawn directly next to an exit. 
This will give you more time to chase them, nuke them, or shuffle the dungeon.

Note: Scroungers also prioritise using the 'core path' exits (black exits, shadow exits), so they may still spawn next to a coloured door, which they ignore if there's a core path exit available.

[h3]Granting Wishes[/h3]
Wishing Well has been an ongoing source of mystery and questions: 
Where did it come from? What does it do? Why did it take my Charm and seemingly to do nothing? 

Well, now it'll take your Charm and do something every time because we've made it act similar to the Siphon Gem spell.

Now it'll give you the primary stats from donated Charms, every time you donate, so using the Well won't ruin a run. It might actually be a good investment! Stonks!

[h3]Item reworks[/h3]
A couple of items have caught our attention in playthroughs!

[b]Light Concoction[/b] previously did damage based on overheal, the effect is now:
[i]Healing missing Health becomes Light damage to all creatures[/i]

We feel this will better encourage strategic play, as it requires you to have high health and juggle damage to make the best use of it. We hope this rework naturally makes it less OP, while still being very fun to use.

[b]Soul Cannon[/b] previously needed you to spend all your souls and do that much damage, now:
[i]Spend 30 Souls, deal 30 Soul Damage to target; 1 Cooldown[/i]

The old design was basically being used to nuke bosses and that's about it. The item wasn't versatile enough to use regularly, and we hope this rework makes it much more useful. It's more like a soul machinegun now - very short cooldowns and effective on anything. 
It'll also synergise better with items which proc on spell use.

[h3]Endgame balance[/h3]
We've noticed the dark ending in particular needed some tuning.
It was spawning cards in a way where people could fill the ring with potions, and get way too many cards in the ring. 

[list]
[*] Improved Potion spawning and Creature limits across the difficulty modes.
[*] Boss Area of Effect attacks are better positioned and spread to avoid inescapable situations.
[*] Boss Area of Effect attacks have damage increased from 5->15 and 15->20.
[*] Updated icons for Area of Effect attacks.
[/list]

[h3]Loot and creature caps[/h3]
Further tuning for a couple of situations where too many 'brutal' creatures could spawn. 
Skull doors are meant to be more challenging but there's a fine line to tread to make sure even rare spawning situations are possible!

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rare ending softlock fixed
[*] Hungry Sun properly considers all sources of explosion damage
[*] Fixed minor bug where stat equip would project damage
[*] Removed projected Light Concoction damage from stat increase
[/list]

Thanks all for the continued thoughts and suggestions! We've been working hard on all this tuning and are excited to get back into content creation.

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
[h3]Beta branch[/h3]
We're going to start doing Beta releases soon for PC on Steam, which will give you a chance to try new features and content before release.

[h3]Roadmap livestream[/h3]
Next week we're going to do a dev livestream to discuss future content plans and potential features. We'll be creating a Steam event for that in coming days so stay tuned! 
Hope to see you there.

notes.content:
[h1]Build notes:[/h1]

[h3]Owl heard a rumour... Do you... not like their gifts?[/h3]
Owl will try harder to please you, and prefer treasure for empty item slots more often.

[h3]Reroll cost reduction[/h3]
To help give you access to more items we’ve reduced most item reroll costs:

[b]Commons [/b]- The first reroll is now free (from 2), increase per roll is still 2.
[b]Rares[/b] - Cost reduced to 3 (from 4).
[b]Epics[/b] - Cost reduced to 6 (from 8).

This should further tune the early game to help you find the best item: [i]Spoon![/i]

[h3]Daily Dungeon unlocks earlier[/h3]
Our Daily Dungeon modifier mode will now unlock at Depth 6 (from 12) to give new players people a taste of this sooner.

[h3]Our loyal dog friends[/h3]
Dogs are now satisfied with fewer [spoiler]pats.[/spoiler] They weren't bugged, they just [spoiler]wanted lots of pats before leaving! Too many pats. Now, not so many pats. If you're playing only for the dog petting, well... maybe we'll add something more for you in the future.[/spoiler]

[h3]Item balance[/h3]
We've done a major audit of our items, sourcing feedback from Steam discussions, Reddit, Twitter, Discord etc to tune a lot of our lacklustre middle tier items. 
Thanks to everyone who provided thoughts on this!

[b]Adjustments (relative to the original stats):[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Generosity[/b] +2 Health & +3 Clarity 
[*] [b]Icebreaker[/b] now deals additional +2 damage to Frozen creatures
[*] [b]Swamp Matter[/b] +2 Def & +1 additional damage to Poisoned creatures 
[*] [b]Camouflage[/b] +2 Def & +5% Dodge 
[*] [b]Touch of Decay[/b] -1 Clarity & +5% Dodge 
[*] [b]Ghostly[/b] +1 Health 
[*] [b]Poison Shield[/b] +1 Poison on Parry 
[*] [b]Merchant[/b] -2 Health & +2 Def 
[*] [b]Mimic Friend[/b] -1 Attack, +2 Def, -1 Clarity & +4 Health
[*] [b]Bronze Leaf[/b] -2 Health 
[*] [b]Unstable Fragments[/b] +2 Speed +1 Clarity 
[*] [b]Sadistic Will[/b] +5% Dodge 
[*] [b]Bloodstone[/b] +1 Health, +10% Dodge & +10% Crit 
[*] [b]Spiky Shield[/b] +2 Reflect damage
[*] [b]Living Corset[/b] +1 Clarity, now guarantees 2 Heal on kill (was 30% chance to Heal 3)
[/list]

Our intention is to balance items which weren't providing the right amount of value, aren't fitting their play style archetype very well, and/or minor adjustments to mitigate randomness.

We have some item redesigns coming soon, which will be added when we have all the translations ready. Including an adjustment to Light Concoction, which is way too powerful. Hilariously powerful! So enjoy that while it lasts. It won't be a huge nerf, we'll be making it's use more strategic and its potential relative to health... Coming soon, a little teaser.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Turbulence and Light Caller now function as intended
[*] FPS settings should now save properly
[*] Area of effect countdowns are no longer affected by spell usage
[*] Added specific missing area of effect damage projections
[*] Rare ending infinite loop fixed
[*] Brittle Seed no longer breaks defence values under specific circumstances
[*] Missing items have returned, hello there!
[/list]

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback. More updates on the way!

notes.title: 1.0.26 Build Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Build notes:[/h1]

Launch has been INTENSE and we really appreciate everyone's support! 
We're getting a lot of great feedback, and have some exciting things lined up.


[h3]Early game loot consistency[/h3]
A number of players have said they feel the early rooms had a bigger impact on their run than they should. 
We've done a pass to make the first level loot more consistent, to help players ease in and kick off their desired build early. 

Previously, early levels had a guaranteed chest and potion, and the rest of the loot was randomised. Now we guarantee the majority of early game loot types. If you've been restarting runs to get a specific distribution, then this should remove that urge and make it more consistent.

[h3]Skulker debuff[/h3]
Skulker was acting almost like a blocking card due to being a very scratchy boy (or girl?), so we've trimmed those claws with -4 to physical attack across all variants. 

[h3]Twitch integration[/h3]
We'll do a proper post on this soon because it deserves a full announcement - Our Twitch integration is now available (though not yet translated) outside the beta branch!

[h3]Bugfix[/h3]
Lots of minor bug fixes and one major one:
A few players reported power surges / computer crashes had corrupted their saves. This update should fix the situation of loading a corrupted save. 
If you still have issues, please get in touch via our [url=https://discord.gg/ringofpain]Discord[/url] bugs channel.


[h3]Some things we're working on for the near future:[/h3]
+Improvements to corpse loot and drops from Owl.
+More items.
+Selectable stat boosts.
+Creating and sharing a roadmap for you all to see.

Again, thanks for all your feedback!
